description: Rule-based proxy client for iOS, iPadOS and macOS. Covers Profile YAML: proxies and protocols, policy groups, rules and rule sets, DNS, modules, URL/header/body rewrites, HTTP captures, widgets and JavaScript scripting.
rules: Egern is not Surge, Loon, Quantumult X or mihomo. Use Egern's documented field names; do not substitute another client's syntax even when the YAML would parse.
Configuration is Profile YAML; scripts use the documented async export default function with the injected ctx object.
Check every cross-reference by name: proxies, policy groups, DNS upstream groups, rule sets and modules must all exist in the profile.
If a field or behaviour is not documented here, say so instead of inferring support from a YAML key parsing.
